AnalysisMetric.description:
Operations supported by the decision intelligence module.
Rejects arbitrary or unsupported queries.

Phase 2 additions:
- OVERVIEW: snapshot-level summary (encounters, images, cameras, time coverage).
- SPECIES_ENCOUNTER_COUNTS: deduplicated encounter/species contributions.
- CAMERA_COMPARISON: per-camera/site encounter and species counts.
- DAILY_ACTIVITY: encounter counts grouped by calendar date.
- HOURLY_ACTIVITY: encounter counts grouped by hour-of-day (0-23).
- SPECIES_CAMERA_MATRIX: species × camera count matrix.
- EFFORT_NORMALISED_RATES: encounters per active camera-day.

description:
Standard envelope enclosing all analytical and review ranking outcomes.

Status semantics:
- OK: Computation completed cleanly against sufficient validated data.
- PARTIAL: Usable result produced, but some records were excluded due to quality/missing fields.
- INSUFFICIENT_DATA: Relevant inputs exist, but their quantity/quality is inadequate (e.g. no effort records).
- UNAVAILABLE: Required capability or prerequisite is absent (e.g. unconfigured model, missing telemetry).
- INVALID_REQUEST: Request parameters failed validation or revision mismatch occurred.
